findings.current: completely stopped his monsters from killing people
findings.defect: The Korean says Morgoth completely controlled the monsters’ killing of people; it does not explicitly say he stopped all killings. The English turns control into a categorical claim that no one was killed.
findings.rationale: 완벽하게 통제했으니 describes completely controlling the monsters’ killing, not necessarily preventing every instance of it.
findings.replacement: kept his monsters’ killing of people completely under control

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one overstatement about Morgoth’s control of the monsters.
